assumptions: This is a conceptual solar-electric high-altitude platform identity, not a defined or flyable aircraft.
The aircraft is electrically propelled for station-keeping; it is not an unpowered glider and its glide capability is not treated as station-keeping energy.
Months-long persistence is a design target/industry proposition for some HAPS platforms, not a demonstrated result for this candidate.
Year-long or multi-year single-airframe continuous operation is not assumed or claimed.
Any power exported to another aircraft is a separate research hypothesis and is unavailable until net export energy and modality-specific link evidence are established.
Published HAPS dimensions, masses, payloads, endurance intentions and wireless-power demonstrations are source-specific references and are not copied into this synthetic candidate.
All physical performance, infrastructure, airspace and safety fields remain unknown until supplied by their owning engineering domains.
